## Before implementing "segmented map production": the group-nonce generator has a hard constraint

This slice is *"the first real producer of `ChunkMap::Segmented`"*, which makes it the first
place a **segment-group nonce** is actually minted. 0016 decision 7 requires it "minted with the
session and independent of its id" (`0016:493-526`), and the design's safety argument for
segment records rests entirely on a genuine **2^-128** collision basis — a weak source degrades
"structurally impossible" to merely improbable, and the documented failure mode is a colliding
group **overwriting a live object's `seg:` records and corrupting its map** (C-1).

**The trap, in one line:** do not mirror `random_chunk_epoch()`
(`crates/server/src/lib.rs:257-263`) even though `0016:493-496` points at the chunk-id epoch as
the model — it yields 64 bits with the top bit forced, not a 128-bit CSPRNG draw. And
`SegmentNonce::new` validates *shape only* (32 chars, `[0-9a-f]`), so nothing downstream catches
a weak source.

Full reasoning, including why the six CodeQL alerts on PR #683 were dismissed and why that
dismissal **must not** be applied by precedent to an alert on this slice's generator:
https://github.com/getwyrd/wyrd/issues/636#issuecomment-5157798348

**Design note from #637's re-plan (2026-09-12): when Complete fences a session into `Completing`, it must write that attempt's segment-group nonce onto the session record.**

**Why.** A metadata restore can bring back a session in `Completing@E` whose `seg:` records were written before its root flip. The restore fence (#664) must then install `retire:records:{seg:<nonce>:<E>}` in the same batch as the fence, or those records have no deleter anywhere in the design (X57, `0016:665`, `:880`). Today `PublishTarget` holds only `parent`, `name` and `epoch` (`crates/core/src/multipart.rs:1842-1849`), so restore cannot name them. #637's first attempt hit exactly this and could only report the records as residue.

**Decision: store the nonce on the `Completing` session record, next to the epoch.**
- #664 (637.4) adds the field. It is required, so a `Completing` record without it fails decode. #664 also teaches the restore fence to read it.
- This issue is the field's writer: the Complete fence that moves a session from `Open` to `Completing` must set it, with the same nonce that attempt's `seg:<nonce>:<E>:` records use.

**Rejected alternative.** `0016:2333` says `group = (<upload-id>, E)`, which would let restore recompute the nonce. But `0016:354` and the code (`multipart.rs:3185-3190`) keep the nonce independent of the upload id on purpose, because segment records outlive the `mpu:` tombstone. 0016 disagrees with itself here; this decision settles it in the code, and the field's doc comment records why.

milestone.title: 0.1 Alpha
milestone.description: First tagged release (Alpha). Scheduled after the two production-metadata milestones complete: #14 (Metadata Store FoundationDB) and #5 (M4 — Production metadata backend) — i.e. after the FDB go/no-go (#442) records go, the default flips to FDB, and TiKV development stands down (#443). No due date yet; it follows those two. Starts empty as the release marker.
